params.body:
Fixes bevinding verwijderen-via-de-api. Fixes #602. Replaces #756, which made the answer truthful
while keeping the door; Shane's call is the other one: if we do not delete, we should not offer the
endpoint either.

Deleting through the partner API was switched off on 6 February 2025 at the customer's request, and
the line that did it is still in the file as a comment. The answer was never changed with it, so the
call kept returning "the vehicle is succesfully deleted" while the vehicle stayed exactly where it
was. A partner reading that believes a car is gone from Stocklist when it is still published.

The route is gone, and the controller method with it. `vehicle/{id}` still matches the GET catch-all
at the end of the group, so a DELETE now answers **405 Method Not Allowed** rather than 404. That is
what "we do not offer this" looks like over HTTP, and it needs no code of its own. Removing vehicles
happens in Stocklist itself.

**Who this breaks, measured rather than assumed.** Over 17 to 22 September 2026 this was the
most-called action of the whole partner API: 4323 calls, 4301 answered "already deleted" (true) and
22 with the sentence that was not. All of them come from a single IP, 82.148.219.135, which reverse
resolves to `outbound.dcb.hexon-is.nl`, user agent "Doorlinken Voorraad". So this is one integration,
Hexon, acting for twelve dealers, and telling them is one message rather than twelve. The 4301 honest
answers break too, and that is the part worth saying out loud before this merges.

The baseline loses four entries that described the removed method, 924 to 920.

Run against the routes as they stand on main, the test fails on "De partner-API hoort geen
verwijderdeur meer te hebben."
params.title: We do not offer what we do not do: the API delete is gone
